prompt: This sumi-e ink painting of a red-crowned crane comes to life and flies in place on plain rice paper. The wings never turn into white outlines or line art. The body, neck, head and trailing legs stay almost still, and the crane keeps exactly its size and place in the frame. Plain empty rice paper, evenly lit, unchanged. Locked-off camera, no zoom, no pan, no new objects, no text, nothing else changes. Nothing red anywhere.
